text:
Düsseldorf’s median asking rent stands at 14.45 €/m², up 4.1 % year‑on‑year and 29.6 % over the past five years, placing the city eighth among the 37 most expensive German markets. The market remains balanced, with a vacancy rate of 1.6 % and an average of 26 days on market; 29 % of listings are let within a week.

Affordability is tight: a 60 m² apartment costs about 867 € per month, while the rent‑burden for two residents is 16 %. Asking rents sit 56 % above the 2022 census existing rent of 9.24 €/m², reflecting a premium of 12.5 – 16.96 €/m² across the interquartile range.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 15.32 €/m² in 12 months, with a range of 14.91 – 15.55 €/m², implying a further 6 % rise.
